title: Cloud SQL Admin: Workload Replay Stop Method Refactored
summary: The `workloadCaptures.stopReplay` method has undergone a breaking refactor. The `workloadId` path parameter is removed, and the `StopWorkloadReplayContext` schema no longer includes `replayInstance` or `workloadId` properties. This requires immediate code updates.
details: The `sqladmin.v1` API has significantly refactored the `workloadCaptures.stopReplay` method. Previously, this method required a `workloadId` as a path parameter, and its request body schema `StopWorkloadReplayContext` included `replayInstance` and `workloadId` properties. All of these have now been removed. This means the method's URI path template has changed from `.../workloadCaptures/{workloadId}:stopReplay` to `.../workloadCaptures:stopReplay`. Developers must update their calls to `workloadCaptures.stopReplay` to remove the `workloadId` from the path and adjust any request body construction that relied on `replayInstance` or `workloadId` within `StopWorkloadReplayContext`. This is a breaking change that impacts how workload replay stopping is initiated.
